versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Micro-Moment Copywriter skill.
- Instantly generates hyper-contextual microcopy (CTAs, subject lines, push notifications, error messages, etc.) tailored to awareness, consideration, decision, and retention micromoments.
- Supports A/B variant generation, conversion psychology templates, and platform-specific optimization (WordPress, Shopify, email, mobile, SaaS, and more).
- Integrates behavioral psychology to drive measurable conversion and reduce user friction.
- Allows custom configuration via parameters like micromoment, copy type, platform, audience, and psychology focus.
